import sys, re

path = "unpacked/word/document.xml"
with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    xml = f.read()

# Simple tokenizer to extract paragraphs with their pPr styles and run texts
paras = re.findall(r"<w:p\b.*?</w:p>", xml, re.S)
print("Total paragraphs:", len(paras))
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    style = re.search(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', p)
    texts = "".join(re.findall(r"<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>", p))
    style_val = style.group(1) if style else ""
    print(f"[{i}] style={style_val!r} text={texts!r}")

import re

path = "unpacked/word/document.xml"
with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    xml = f.read()

paras = re.findall(r"<w:p\b.*?</w:p>", xml, re.S)
headline_idx = [0, 5, 14, 24, 29, 39, 44]
for i in headline_idx:
    print(f"===== Paragraph {i} =====")
    print(paras[i])
    print()

import sys

sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx")

from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document("unpacked", rsid="D8FC28AD")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]

# Pre-edit scan: find all runs with headline font size (sz=24)
print("=== Runs with sz=24 before edit ===")
for r in editor.dom.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
    szs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:sz")
    if szs and szs[0].getAttribute("w:val") == "24":
        texts = r.getElementsByTagName("w:t")
        t = texts[0].firstChild.data if texts and texts[0].firstChild else ""
        print(repr(t))

headlines = [
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
]

changed = []
for text in headlines:
    node = editor.get_node(tag="w:r", contains=text)
    rpr = node.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")[0]
    if rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
        print(f"SKIP (already underlined): {text}")
        continue
    u = editor.dom.createElement("w:u")
    u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
    # Schema-correct position: after sz-cs (or sz), before any later rPr children
    anchor = None
    for tag in ("w:sz-cs", "w:sz"):
        found = rpr.getElementsByTagName(tag)
        if found:
            anchor = found[0]
            break
    if anchor is not None:
        rpr.insertBefore(u, anchor.nextSibling)
    else:
        rpr.appendChild(u)
    changed.append(text)

print("=== Underlined ===")
for t in changed:
    print(t)

print("=== Post-edit verification ===")
for t in headlines:
    node = editor.get_node(tag="w:r", contains=t)
    rpr = node.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")[0]
    has_u = len(rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u")) > 0
    print(f"{t}: underlined={has_u}")

doc.save()
print("Saved OK")

import re

path = "unpacked/word/document.xml"
with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    xml = f.read()

# Scan: which runs use headline font size (sz=24)?
print("=== Runs with sz=24 before edit ===")
for m in re.finditer(r"<w:r\b[^>]*>.*?</w:r>", xml, re.S):
    run = m.group(0)
    if '<w:sz w:val="24"/>' in run:
        t = re.search(r"<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>", run)
        print(repr(t.group(1) if t else ""))

headlines = [
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
]

marker = '<w:sz-cs w:val="24"/>'
insert = '<w:u w:val="single"/>'
count = 0
for text in headlines:
    idx = xml.find(f"<w:t xml:space=\"preserve\">{text}</w:t>")
    assert idx != -1, f"headline not found: {text}"
    j = xml.rfind(marker, 0, idx)
    assert j != -1, f"sz-cs marker not found for: {text}"
    assert '<w:u w:val="single"/>' not in xml[j:idx], f"already underlined: {text}"
    pos = j + len(marker)
    xml = xml[:pos] + insert + xml[pos:]
    count += 1

with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(xml)

print(f"Underlined {count} headlines")

# Verify
with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    xml = f.read()
print("=== Verification: headline runs now contain w:u ===")
for text in headlines:
    idx = xml.find(f"<w:t xml:space=\"preserve\">{text}</w:t>")
    seg = xml[max(0, idx - 200):idx]
    print(f"{text}: has_u={'<w:u w:val=\"single\"/>' in seg}")

import re

with open("unpacked/word/document.xml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    xml = f.read()

for text in ["EXECUTIVE SUMMARY", "OPERATING EXPENSES"]:
    idx = xml.find(f"<w:t xml:space=\"preserve\">{text}</w:t>")
    start = xml.rfind("<w:p>", 0, idx)
    end = xml.find("</w:p>", idx) + len("</w:p>")
    print(f"===== {text} =====")
    print(xml[start:end])
    print()
